retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1980s rock aesthetic featuring a dynamic musician portrait over a desaturated, high-contrast stadium crowd with bold, slanted script lettering.
triggerTerms: musician with electric guitar in leather jacket

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male rock musician in a dark leather jacket, angled away from the viewer while looking back over his shoulder. He holds an electric guitar, positioned against a bright, hazy, and desaturated background of a cheering stadium crowd. The layout is anchored by a large, diagonally-oriented red script title in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in dark, saturated tones against a light, washed-out background
Diagonal typography mirroring the angle of the musician's shoulders
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face and hands to emphasize action
Text elements layered both behind and in front of the subject's silhouette
coreInvariants: Dark leather texture on the primary subject
Slanted, thick-stroke script for the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician occupies the left half and bottom center, scaled to a medium-close-up profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face and the large red script logo create two primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the guitar neck upward to the musician's face, then across to the slanted title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right and lower right areas are filled with a bright, textured crowd pattern.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and browns (leather jacket and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value/low saturation background vs. low value/high saturation foreground.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, gold, black, and desaturated tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight brush script and condensed serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title features a 15-degree upward slant
Thick, fluid strokes with rounded terminals
Tight kerning with overlapping characters in the script
Secondary text uses high-contrast, condensed serif forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' in the script is oversized and acts as a decorative flourish
Roman numerals are stylized with heavy slab serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, slanted script paired with rigid, vertical condensed serifs.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal lines for header text

preserve: Red color of the main title
Condensed nature of the secondary serif

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s energy and stroke weight
Matches the high-contrast serif secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a male rock musician with 80s hair in a black leather jacket, holding an electric guitar and looking back over his shoulder. The background should be a bright, overexposed, and desaturated stadium crowd with a hazy atmosphere.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, red, slanted brush script title in the upper right. Add a gold condensed serif subtitle directly below it. Place small, wide-tracked serif text along the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the background crowd sufficiently desaturated?
Does the red script have a clear upward diagonal slant?
Is the musician's jacket showing leather texture and highlights?

mustAchieve: Dynamic, non-static pose for the musician

postGenerationChecks: Check for 80s-appropriate hair and clothing style
Ensure the guitar looks like a vintage electric model
Verify the text does not obscure the musician's face
Confirm the color palette is restricted to the specified tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Musician in leather + desaturated stadium crowd + slanted red script = 80s Rock Soundtrack Aesthetic
